newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Barito active on Suharto daughter rumours.
newsitem.headline: Barito active on Suharto daughter rumours.

text.p: Shares of Indonesia's PT Barito Pacific Timber were active in early Monday trading on rumours that President Suharto's daugther could take a stake in the timber conglomerate, brokers said.
Barito topped the active list in early trading, with volume approaching three million shares after 80 minutes. The share rose 50 rupiah to 1,575 rupiah, down from a high of 1,600.

"Barito is very active on market talk that Mbak Tutut (Siti Hardianti Rukmana) may buy a stake in Barito," one senior broker with a foreign brokerage said. Rukmana, who heads toll-road operator Citra Marga, is Suharto's eldest daughter.
"We can't comment (on the rumour). Maybe Barito is very active because we had a nice first half and people are realising value in Barito," Barito spokesman Steve Back told Reuters.
Officials at Citra Marga were not immediately available for comment.

Barito posted a net profit of 37.16 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1996 against 38.72 billion rupiah in the same period in 1995. But analysts have said the slight fall in profits represented a better performance than expected.
